compiled_state.title: GREEN: Update CLAUDE.md architecture pointers for recipe task integration
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## What
Update CLAUDE.md's Architecture (pointers) section to document the recipe: task type, pre-flight check, cleanup phase, and LLM fallback — adding them alongside existing architectural pointers.

## Why
CLAUDE.md is for agent instructions and architecture pointers. Future sprint and implementation-plan agents need to know that recipe: tasks exist and how the four-component pipeline works.

## Acceptance Criteria
- CLAUDE.md Architecture section gains a new line under the relevant heading: '**Recipe integration into planning and sprint** (recipe: task type, pre-flight, cleanup, fallback): consult-recipe-registry.sh reads registry during implementation-plan; recipe: tasks dispatch via recipe-executor.sh in Phase E; pre-flight via check-recipe-engines.sh in Phase C Step 1; cleanup via detect-cleanup-recipes.sh in Phase F; LLM fallback via translate-recipe-to-llm-task.sh when engine unavailable. See .claude/design-notes.md for integration decisions.'
- The CLAUDE.md Architectural Invariants section is NOT bloated with per-component details — a single pointer is sufficient per the CLAUDE.md bloat criteria
- No duplicate rules added — check existing content before writing
- The line does not exceed ~150 characters (CLAUDE.md pointer convention)

## File Impact
- MODIFY: CLAUDE.md

## Testing Mode
GREEN — doc-only update; no executable behavior

## Dependencies
None (can run in parallel with Task 2)
